profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon, a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA, trading under the ticker AMZN. AWS's most recently reported annual revenue for the period ending 2025-12-31 was $716,924,000,000, as filed in a 10-K. The company's website for this profile centers on Amazon SageMaker, which the site describes as "the center for all your data, analytics, and AI," positioning it as an integrated environment for machine learning, analytics, and generative AI development.

Amazon SageMaker is tracked as a cloud AI service covering the full ML lifecycle, including model monitoring, bias detection, and explainability tools. The site describes its next-generation form as SageMaker Unified Studio, a managed environment that brings together tools for model development, data processing, SQL analytics, and generative AI application building. Component capabilities cited include HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps tooling, alongside Amazon Q Developer, described on the site as a generative AI assistant for software development tasks such as data discovery, model building, SQL generation, and pipeline creation. Data connectivity spans Amazon S3 data lakes, Amazon Redshift warehouses, Apache Iceberg-compatible sources, and third-party federated sources, with governance handled through Amazon SageMaker Catalog. AWS Bedrock is also tracked as a separate managed foundation model API service, offering IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and an AgentCore component for agent orchestration.

No litigation cases are recorded in the held facts for this entity.
